description: Restricted to what the frontend actually calls: core:event's allow-listen, for the `listen()` calls that receive the `snapshot`/`usage`/`connection-status` events (src/main.ts) and the wizard's `engine-install-log` event (Phase 1.6 §4.1, src/wizard/wizard.ts), plus the two window permissions the custom title bar needs (spec phase1.5 §3 "Window"): allow-start-dragging for the `data-tauri-drag-region` title bar, and allow-internal-toggle-maximize for its double-click-to-maximize. Window min/max/close themselves are Rust commands (window_minimize/window_toggle_maximize/window_close in commands.rs), not core:window JS permissions. No fs, shell, or http plugin permissions are granted. The dialog, notification, opener, and autostart plugins are called from Rust only (folder/theme-file pickers, desktop toasts, Settings.../config.toml, and herdr menu ▸ Start at Login), so the webview gets no `dialog:*`/`notification:*`/`opener:*`/`autostart:*` permission either. The app's own #[tauri::command] functions (commands.rs, engine.rs, statusline.rs -- including the raw-bytes Channel used for surface frames) are callable from the webview without a separate ACL entry.
